paragraphs: In [Shevuot 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Shevuot.17b.12), Rava said in the name of Rav Shmuel bar Shava, who said in the name of Rav Huna.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The supplied Hebrew reads Shevuot 13a. Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1147) appears to give 17a.
The linked passage gives all three links: Rava, Rav Shmuel bar Shava, and Rav Huna. This supports reading the abbreviation ר״ה as Rav Huna here.
The linked Davidson edition places this report at 17b. Hyman’s notice ends after the chain.
